siteInfo: TestCorp is a software testing company specializing in CI/CD pipeline automation and quality assurance tools. We provide testing frameworks, integration services, and developer training programs for enterprise teams.

profilesInfo.developer: Software developers and engineers who need help with testing frameworks, unit testing, integration testing, and CI/CD pipelines. They typically use Node.js, Python, or Java.
profilesInfo.qa-engineer: Quality assurance professionals who manage test suites, automate regression testing, and oversee release quality processes.
profilesInfo.manager: Engineering managers who need visibility into test coverage, quality metrics, and team productivity across multiple projects.

contactInfo: Email: contact@testcorp.com, Phone: +1-555-0123. Business hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm EST. Emergency support available for enterprise customers.
